title: Rooks Around the Ponds
description:
## Task

A garden is an `n` by `n` grid of squares. Some squares are ponds and cannot hold a rook. Place `n` rooks so that every row and every column has exactly one rook and no rook stands on a pond. Count the different placements.

## Input

- `n` — the side length of the grid.
- `ponds` — a list of `[row, col]` pairs (0-based) marking pond squares.

## Output

The number of valid placements of `n` rooks.

## Example

```python
rooks_around_the_ponds(2, [])  # returns 2
rooks_around_the_ponds(2, [[0, 0]])  # returns 1
rooks_around_the_ponds(3, [[0, 0], [1, 1], [2, 2]])  # returns 2
```

## Constraints

- 1 ≤ `n` ≤ 13
- 0 ≤ length of `ponds` ≤ `n` * `n`
- Pond squares are inside the grid; a square may be listed twice.
signature: def rooks_around_the_ponds(n: int, ponds: list[list[int]]) -> int
